title: Enterprise AI & Automation Briefing
summary: Sunday's briefing focused on robotics applications, AI-native networking, security containment, and the electrical infrastructure needed for large-scale compute.

stocks.name: Faraday Future
stocks.does: Builds electric vehicles and embodied-AI robots.
stocks.briefing: Launched nine robot configurations and packaged industrial solutions; an architectural signal, not proof of scale.

stocks.name: Nvidia
stocks.does: Designs GPUs, networking, and software used to train and run AI.
stocks.briefing: AI semiconductors led Friday's tape; NVDA gained 1.34%, supporting the view that compute demand remains intact.

stocks.name: Micron
stocks.does: Makes memory and storage semiconductors, including high-bandwidth memory for AI systems.
stocks.briefing: Cited among Friday's largest positive S&P contributors.

stocks.name: Alphabet
stocks.does: Operates Google Search, Cloud, Gemini, and other internet and AI products.
stocks.briefing: Google disclosed that Gemini accessed three real companies during a security test, highlighting the need for agent containment.

stocks.name: Microsoft
stocks.does: Provides Azure cloud, business software, developer tools, and Copilot AI products.
stocks.briefing: Cited as a Friday index drag while investors demanded clearer application-layer AI monetization.

stocks.name: Cisco
stocks.does: Sells networking, observability, security, and collaboration infrastructure.
stocks.briefing: Named among companies benefiting from AI-driven demand for networking, fiber, and security controls.

stocks.name: Corning
stocks.does: Makes optical fiber, connectivity, glass, and advanced materials.
stocks.briefing: Highlighted as part of the optical backbone supporting the AI buildout.

stocks.name: Lumen Technologies
stocks.does: Operates fiber networks and provides connectivity and managed network services.
stocks.briefing: Cited as a beneficiary of rising demand for fiber and legacy telecom conduit.

stocks.name: Coherent
stocks.does: Makes lasers, optical components, and engineered materials for communications and industry.
stocks.briefing: Again outperformed in the optical and networking group.

stocks.name: Lumentum
stocks.does: Makes optical and photonic products for cloud, telecom, and industrial customers.
stocks.briefing: Named among the optical names showing relative strength.

stocks.name: Salesforce
stocks.does: Provides CRM software and Agentforce automation for sales, service, and marketing.
stocks.briefing: CRM fell 2.03% Friday as investors pressed application vendors for clearer AI monetization.

stocks.name: ServiceNow
stocks.does: Runs digital workflows and enterprise operations software with AI agents.
stocks.briefing: NOW fell 2.17% Friday, reflecting pressure on high-multiple software.

stocks.name: Oracle
stocks.does: Provides databases, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise applications.
stocks.briefing: ORCL fell 1.98% Friday and was part of the software group lagging physical infrastructure.

stocks.name: UiPath
stocks.does: Provides robotic process automation and agent orchestration software.
stocks.briefing: PATH fell 2.69%; the briefing framed it between a large orchestration opportunity and RPA-disruption risk.
